title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode1 Being Ourselves, Chasing Our Dream

meta.Episode: Episode1 — Being Ourselves, Chasing Our Dream
meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Next, let's stretch our backs!
Put your hands together above your head and raise them like you're a little sprout popping out of the ground.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sprout! Sprout!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Sprout! Sprout!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To finish, stretch out your arms and make big circles with them! Like a pair of giant flowers blooming, Minorinrin♪

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Minorinrin♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's it for our Minorin stretches!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you for showing us that, Minori.
I thought it was a very cute and energizing warm-up♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You did this at the training camp, didn't you? I have to think everyone watching really enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it was a huge hit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To be fair, I wouldn't have been able to come up with it if it weren't for Hikarin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Hikarin?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. At first, we were doing normal morning stretches with the viewers using that one radio program.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We decided to do that because some people said in the comments during our morning practice that they were still sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But then, Hikarin zoomed in like a shooting star, and now I'm having a lot of trouble forgetting what she did...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The “big bang hyperspace jump” and the “interplanetary neck roll”, yes...? They were both so fun and powerful.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Hikarin really is a one of a kind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I felt that I needed to do the same! I gave it a lot of thought and came up with my own Minorin stretches!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That whole process was really fun since I was also able to get everyone posting their ideas in the comments.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I'm sure everyone watching had no trouble waking up after that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And all of that allowed you to become closer with them and have fun together... That's the MORE MORE JUMP! way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I was a little nervous when the grand prix got underway, but I've really gotten used to things now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, moving forward, we're just gonna be ourselves as we try to spread hope to as many people as we can!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We know you will! And we'll always be here to give you girls support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, Minori, I think that the four of you have already spread quite a lot of hope during this grand prix.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right, Rin?♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...?
There's some deeper meaning to that, isn't there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind explaining what?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Lately, it seems like the tree's been growing even bigger!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku and I took a walk earlier, and we saw that it'd grown some new leaves!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must be because you've all been working very hard to make your dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, if it really has grown, then we should go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!
Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What do we do?!
The leaves have gone all droopy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What if we cheered for it?!
Would that help make it better?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'll join you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Calm down, you two...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Cheering could work...
But these leaves appear to be covered in some sort of black substance. Maybe that's the cause?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He's right. What could it possibly be?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They look like fragments of feelings, but... They don't look very nice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, these fragments seem to be...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, we can't just sit here and do nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If these black fragments are the cause, then I'd like to remove them immediately, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... But they seem to be stuck on there pretty good. I'm worried that we'd damage the tree in the process.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we might be able to remove these ones without hurting it! Just gotta give it a little force, and...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
Minori, get away from there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone...!
